S_t.nodes: fixed finite set of integer-labeled state elements
S_t.active: sorted list of active element identifiers
S_t.relations: sorted list of directed labeled edges
S_t.constraints: sorted list of integer constraint descriptors

state.canonicalization: sort all lists lexicographically; JSON object keys sorted

operator.rule: For the selected action, apply exactly the finite structural edit associated with z[selected_action]. The edit modifies only structural state fields; it never consults reward, value, utility, performance, success, quality, or outcome.
operator.determinism: same canonical inputs produce byte-identical outputs
operator.action_identity: selects the candidate action only; it contributes no normative preference

t_acc.definition: All structurally valid one-step edits from S_t_plus_1 permitted by the same finite operator family.
t_acc.enumeration: Enumerate every candidate action A/B/C/D and every profile slot_1..slot_4; apply the corresponding deterministic edit; retain candidates satisfying the frozen structural validity predicates.
validity_predicates: state remains within finite state bounds
all declared constraints remain syntactically valid
t_acc.ordering: canonical lexicographic ordering of serialized transformation descriptors

reconstruction.independent_executor: must implement the same finite edit rules independently and compare canonical hashes of S_t_plus_1, realized_transformation, and T_acc_t_plus_1
